body.name: primitive response-interior comparison subclass
body.construction:
Fix \(\eta\in(0,1/2)\).  Define the primitive response-interior subclass
\[
\mathfrak P_{\kappa,\eta}^{\mathrm{int}}
=\left\{\mathbb P\in\mathfrak P_{\kappa}^{0}:
\eta\leq\mu_{n,cx}\leq1-\eta
\ \text{for every }n\geq1\text{ and every }(c,x)\in\mathcal C\times\mathcal X
\right\}.
\]
This condition is stated in the primitive Bernoulli response law, is independently checkable, and excludes the collapsing-response singleton without encoding a critical value or coverage conclusion.
